AI VISION LAB — hardware acceptance checklist
=============================================
Run this on the TARGET machine only
(Windows 11 · i7-12700F · RTX 4060 Ti · webcam · optional Ollama / SD WebUI / ComfyUI).

Nothing here is a result. Tick a box only after YOU saw it work.

A. One-click pack
   [ ] Double-click scripts\setup_windows.bat   (venv + deps + models + check)
   [ ] Double-click scripts\accept_windows.bat  (check + smoke + auto acceptance + 2 min stability)
       For a production READY verdict later:
   [ ] scripts\accept_windows.bat --minutes 10

B. Interactive 20-step workflow
   python scripts\hardware_acceptance.py --json acceptance.json --reports .

   [ ] START APP            window opens on Home
   [ ] SYSTEM CHECK         9 badges, no unexpected FAIL
   [ ] START LIVE           camera feed + LIVE HUD
   [ ] PERSON DETECTED      HUD PERSONS = 01
   [ ] BODY                 inspector shows a body
   [ ] ARMS                 raise each arm — states change
   [ ] HANDS                open palm — skeleton + gesture
   [ ] OBJECTS              cup/mouse — OBJECTS count rises
   [ ] SCENE                capture unlocks GENERATE FROM SCENE
   [ ] CAPTURE SCENE        GENERATE FROM SCENE enabled
   [ ] AI CONTEXT           COPY SCENE puts text on the clipboard
   [ ] GENERATE IMAGE       result appears (any provider, including Mock)
   [ ] ANALYZE              MATCH / CONFIDENCE / QUALITY fill
   [ ] FEEDBACK             rating stored on the record
   [ ] REGENERATE           v2 arrives and is analyzed
   [ ] COMPARE              side-by-side + blend + DIFF
   [ ] SAVE                 SAVE COPY writes a PNG
   [ ] GALLERY              both versions with badges
   [ ] DETAIL               INFO / VERSIONS / ANALYSIS / FEEDBACK
   [ ] VERSION HISTORY      v1 → v2 lineage

C. Phase 28 extras (optional, not blocking READY)
   [ ] RECORD               VISION → RECORD writes a local video under data\recordings
   [ ] SNAPSHOT             VISION → SNAPSHOT writes a JPEG next to it
   [ ] LISTEN               Assistant LISTEN (Windows SAPI) or stays honestly hidden
   [ ] ComfyUI              CREATE provider "ComfyUI (local)" · ONLINE only if ComfyUI is running

D. Packaging
   [ ] packaging\windows.bat                         EXE starts
   [ ] scripts\create_shortcut.ps1                   Desktop shortcut works

E. Gate
   [ ] python scripts\release_gate.py
       Software PASS is expected.
       READY only appears with a fresh same-machine READY acceptance report.
       Missing reports are never treated as PASS.

Verdicts
   PASS        the test really ran here and succeeded
   FAIL        the test really ran here and failed — fix it
   UNTESTABLE  could not run here (no device / service / Windows) — never counted as PASS
   READY       every production-relevant step is REAL VERIFIED
   NOT READY   at least one relevant test really failed
   INCOMPLETE  not enough real hardware data
